"""Publish bounded synthetic progress/cancellation records; no audio/raw reports."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import difflib
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import sys

parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
parser.add_argument('--capture',type=Path,required=True)
parser.add_argument('--expected-main-sha256',required=True)
args=parser.parse_args()
repo=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
scratch=repo/'.wac-local/WAC-M3-04'
destination=repo/'docs/codex/winaudioclean/evidence'
runtime_names=['WinAudioClean.ps1','WinAudioClean.IO.ps1','WinAudioClean.Preview.ps1','WinAudioClean.Settings.ps1','WinAudioClean.Batch.ps1','WinAudioClean.Queue.ps1']


def sha(data):return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def require(value,message):
    if not value:raise ValueError(message)


def sanitized(value):
    if isinstance(value,str):
        for original,replacement in [(str(repo),'<repo>'),(str(Path.home()),'<user-profile>')]:
            pattern=r'[\\/]+'.join(re.escape(part) for part in re.split(r'[\\/]+',original))
            value=re.sub(pattern,lambda match:replacement,value,flags=re.I)
        value=re.sub(r'(<S N="(?:User|Computer|PSComputerName)">)[^<]*(</S>)',r'\1<local-identity>\2',value)
        for key in ['USERNAME','COMPUTERNAME','USERDOMAIN']:
            if os.environ.get(key):value=re.sub(re.escape(os.environ[key]),'<local-identity>',value,flags=re.I)
        return value
    if isinstance(value,dict):return {key:sanitized(item) for key,item in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value,list):return [sanitized(item) for item in value]
    return value


def local_record(path):
    data=path.read_bytes()
    return {'path':path.relative_to(repo).as_posix(),'sha256':sha(data),'bytes':len(data)}


def publish(name,data):
    path=destination/name;require(not path.exists(),'Refusing to replace existing public artifact '+name)
    encoded=(json.dumps(sanitized(data),indent=2,ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False)+'\n').encode('utf-8')
    path.write_bytes(encoded);record=local_record(path);print(json.dumps(record));return record


def events_projection(events):
    groups={};other=[];inspections=[]
    for event in events:
        if event['kind']=='progress':
            state=event['state'];key=(event['inputPath'],state['FileIndex'],state['Stage'],state['StartPercent'],state['EndPercent'])
            groups.setdefault(key,[]).append(event)
        elif event['kind'].startswith('native_') and not event['stage']:
            item={key:event[key] for key in ['kind','sequence','atUtc','hostPid','inputPath']}
            if event['kind']=='native_start':
                item.update(executable=event['executable'],captured_sanitized_arguments_sha256=sha(json.dumps(event['arguments'],ensure_ascii=False).encode('utf-8')))
            else:item.update({key:event[key] for key in ['started','exitCode','cancelled','ownedProcessId','timedOut','error','cleanupError']})
            inspections.append(item)
        else:
            item=dict(event)
            if item['kind']=='native_start':
                original=item.pop('originalArguments')
                item['captured_sanitized_original_arguments_sha256']=sha(json.dumps(original,ensure_ascii=False).encode('utf-8'))
                item['arguments_unmodified']=original==item['arguments']
            other.append(item)
    states=[]
    for key,rows in groups.items():
        first,last=rows[0],rows[-1];percent=[r['state']['Percent'] for r in rows]
        def boundary(row):
            state=row['state']
            return {'sequence':row['sequence'],'atUtc':row['atUtc'],'percent':state['Percent'],'processedSeconds':state['ProcessedSeconds'],
                    'structuredEnd':state['StructuredEnd'],'processId':state['ProcessId'],'displayCompleted':row['displayCompleted'],'snapshot':row['snapshot']}
        states.append({'inputPath':key[0],'fileIndex':key[1],'fileCount':last['state']['FileCount'],'stage':key[2],'startPercent':key[3],'endPercent':key[4],
                       'durationSeconds':last['state']['DurationSeconds'],
                       'eventCount':len(rows),'observedPercentMin':min(percent),'observedPercentMax':max(percent),
                       'first':boundary(first),'last':boundary(last)})
    return {'scope':'All media native argv/results, actions/publications and compact first/last/extrema of every stage/range. Inspection argv are represented by sanitized-argument hashes and actual outcomes; complete raw event bytes remain ignored and hashed.',
            'stage_observations':states,'native_action_publication_events':other,'native_inspection_outcomes':inspections}


def report_projection(record):
    report=record['report']
    result={key:record[key] for key in ['path','sha256','bytes']}
    result['fields']={key:report[key] for key in ['schemaVersion','jobId','status','applicationExitCode','presetId','presetVersion','presetExperimental','presetCustomized','settings','progress','warningCodes']}
    for key in ['processingStatus','processingExitCode','nativeExitCode','reasonCodes']:
        if key in report:result['fields'][key]=report[key]
    result['fields']['input']=report['input']
    if report.get('reportType')=='preview':
        result['fields'].update(reportType='preview',range=report['range'],normalization=report['normalization'])
        result['fields']['assets']={role:{key:item[key] for key in ['path','exactFilters','gainDb','frames','format']} for role,item in report['assets'].items()}
    else:
        result['fields']['normalization']={key:report['normalization'].get(key) for key in ['requestedMode','prechain','analysisFilter','renderFilter','finalMeasurementFilter','linearRequested','actualType','fallbackReason']}
        result['fields']['output']={key:report['output'][key] for key in ['path','published','validity','format']}
    return result


capture_path=args.capture.resolve(strict=True)
require(capture_path.is_relative_to(scratch),'Capture outside ignored task scratch')
capture=json.loads(capture_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
require(capture['status']=='pass' and capture['scope']['unfiltered'],'Final capture must be unfiltered and pass')
require(len(capture['cases'])==20 and all(c['passed'] and all(c['checks'].values()) for c in capture['cases']),'Final twenty-case ledger failed')
guard_names=['sources_unchanged','files_unchanged','copies_unchanged','tools_unchanged']
require(all(capture[key] for key in guard_names),'Final capture guard failed')
runtime_now={name:sha((repo/name).read_bytes()) for name in runtime_names}
require(all(capture['source_sha256_before'][name]==capture['source_sha256_after'][name]==runtime_now[name] for name in runtime_names),'Physical product differs at publication')
require(re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}',args.expected_main_sha256) is not None,'Invalid expected main hash')
require(runtime_now['WinAudioClean.ps1']==args.expected_main_sha256,'Unexpected frozen main source')

cases=[]
for case in capture['cases']:
    result={key:case[key] for key in ['id','passed','checks']}
    result['events']=events_projection(case['events'])
    events_path=capture_path.parent/'cases'/case['id']/('unknown-native-events.jsonl' if 'application_rejection' in case else 'events.jsonl')
    result['complete_local_events']=local_record(events_path)
    if 'application_rejection' in case:
        result.update(scope=case['scope'],application_rejection=case['application_rejection'],native_result=case['native_result'])
    else:
        result.update(result=case['result'],assets=case['assets'],reports=[report_projection(r) for r in case['reports']])
    if 'variable_flow_note' in case:result['variable_flow_note']=case['variable_flow_note']
    if 'action' in case:
        result.update(action=case['action'],journal=case['journal'],independent_native_pid_at_action=case['independent_native_pid_at_action'])
        foreign=capture_path.parent/'cases'/case['id']/'exports/foreign.wav'
        foreign_record=local_record(foreign)
        expected_stereo=next(f['sha256'] for f in capture['fixtures'] if f.get('id')=='stereo')
        require(foreign_record['sha256']==expected_stereo,'Foreign sentinel differs from copied source')
        result['foreign_synthetic_sentinel']=dict(foreign_record,proof='Created by copying the stereo fixture before dispatch, remembered by the harness and covered by final files_unchanged; rechecked at publication.')
    if 'independent' in case:
        independent=case['independent'];result['independent']={'result':independent['result'],'assets':independent['assets'],'reports':[report_projection(r) for r in independent['reports']],
                                                             'events':events_projection(independent['events'])}
    cases.append(result)

references=[{'id':reference['id'],'application_exit':reference['application_exit'],'assets':reference['assets'],'reports':[report_projection(r) for r in reference['reports']]} for reference in capture['references']]
unknown=[c for c in cases if 'application_rejection' in c]
cancelled=[c for c in cases if c.get('action',{}).get('kind')=='request']
abnormal=[c for c in cases if c.get('action',{}).get('kind')=='unexpected_owned_exit']
success=[c for c in cases if c not in unknown+cancelled+abnormal]
case_exports=sum(len(c.get('assets',[])) for c in cases)
independent_exports=sum(len(c.get('independent',{}).get('assets',[])) for c in cases)
reference_exports=sum(len(r['assets']) for r in references)
app_commands=[command for command in capture['commands'] if command['id'].startswith('app-')]
counts={'final_cases':len(cases),'passed_cases':sum(c['passed'] for c in cases),'success_progress_cases':len(success),
        'unknown_duration_cases_native_only_plus_app_rejection':len(unknown),'real_context_cancelled_active_jobs':len(cancelled),
        'unexpected_owned_ffmpeg_exits':len(abnormal),'independent_survivors':len(cancelled),
        'primary_case_published_wavs':case_exports,'independent_published_wavs':independent_exports,'reference_published_wavs':reference_exports,
        'all_published_app_wavs':case_exports+independent_exports+reference_exports,
        'unique_case_and_independent_pcm_comparisons':case_exports+independent_exports,
        'top_level_application_invocations':len(app_commands),'direct_reference_invocations':len(references),
        'direct_unknown_native_null_sink_invocations':sum(command['id'].startswith('native-') for command in capture['commands']),
        'queue_journals':len(cancelled+abnormal),'queue_child_starts':2*len(cancelled)+3*len(abnormal),
        'pending_queue_items_not_started':sum(sum(i.get('status')=='NOT_STARTED' for i in c['journal']) for c in cancelled),
        'cancelled_and_failed_target_detailed_reports':sum(sum(r['fields'].get('processingStatus') in ['FAILED','CANCELLED'] for r in c['reports']) for c in cancelled+abnormal)}
require(counts['all_published_app_wavs']==64 and counts['unique_case_and_independent_pcm_comparisons']==38 and counts['top_level_application_invocations']==40,'Unexpected final app/audio counts')
require(len(cancelled)==6 and len(abnormal)==2 and len(unknown)==2 and len(success)==10,'Unexpected acceptance scopes')
cancelled_native_results=[]
for case in cancelled:
    rows=[event for event in case['events']['native_action_publication_events'] if event['kind']=='native_result' and event['cancelled']]
    require(len(rows)==1,'Expected one actual cancelled native result for '+case['id'])
    result=rows[0]
    require(result['error'] is None and result['cleanupError'] is None,'Cancelled native process/read/cleanup error in '+case['id'])
    if result['stage']=='Verification':require(bool(result['cancellationInputError']),'Verification cancellation must record the observed ended-pipe classification')
    cancelled_native_results.append({'id':case['id'],'stage':result['stage'],'ownedProcessId':result['ownedProcessId'],'cancelled':result['cancelled'],
                                     'nativeExitCode':result['exitCode'],'error':result['error'],'cleanupError':result['cleanupError'],'cancellationInputError':result['cancellationInputError']})

preliminary=[]
for folder in ['media-smoke-fast','media-smoke-accurate-unknown','media-smoke-cancel-rendering','media-smoke-ps7','media-smoke-final-harness','media-final']:
    path=scratch/folder/'summary.json';data=json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    preliminary.append(dict(local_record(path),status=data['status'],scope=data['scope'],error=data.get('error'),
                            harness_invocation=data['harness_invocation'],source_sha256_before=data['source_sha256_before'],source_sha256_after=data['source_sha256_after'],
                            copies_before=data.get('instrumentation',{}).get('copies_before'),guards={key:data[key] for key in guard_names},
                            cases=[{'id':c['id'],'passed':c['passed'],'failed_checks':[key for key,value in c['checks'].items() if not value]} for c in data['cases']],
                            command_outcomes=[{key:command[key] for key in ['id','exit_code','timed_out','stdout_native_bytes_sha256','stderr_native_bytes_sha256']} for command in data['commands'] if command['id'].startswith(('app-','native-'))]))
old=(scratch/'harness-before-unknown-policy-fix.py').read_bytes();new=(scratch/'test-progress-media.py').read_bytes()
previous_path=scratch/'media-final-corrected/summary.json'
previous=json.loads(previous_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
require(previous['status']=='pass' and previous['scope']['unfiltered'] and len(previous['cases'])==20 and all(item['passed'] for item in previous['cases']),'Prior accepted twenty-case capture failed')
require(all(previous[key] for key in guard_names),'Prior accepted capture guard failed')
previous_accepted={'capture':local_record(previous_path),'status':'pass','counts':{'final_cases':20,'passed_cases':20},'scope':previous['scope'],
                   'harness_invocation':previous['harness_invocation'],'source_sha256_before':previous['source_sha256_before'],'source_sha256_after':previous['source_sha256_after'],
                   'guards':{key:previous[key] for key in guard_names},'case_outcomes':[{'id':case['id'],'passed':case['passed']} for case in previous['cases']],
                   'public_projection_files':[local_record(scratch/'publication-main-286a'/name) for name in ['WAC-M3-04-media.json','WAC-M3-04-media-harness.json','WAC-M3-04-media-manifest.json']],
                   'disposition':'Earlier accepted unfiltered20 capture on main286A remains preserved, including its public projection bytes. It is superseded by this fresh matrix after narrow cancellation-input classification and cancellation/report timing corrections; it is not relabeled as a final-current-source gate.'}
correction={'reason':'Initial final run omitted process-only ExecutionPolicy Bypass on the separate PS5.1 dot-source native helper. Policy blocked it; nonterminating errors returned0 but missing required events caused the harness to fail. Add the same process-only flag as ordinary wrappers and Stop error handling. Runtime and security settings were unchanged; a fresh unfiltered20 run was completed.',
            'before_sha256':sha(old),'after_sha256':sha(new),'unified_diff':''.join(difflib.unified_diff(old.decode().splitlines(keepends=True),new.decode().splitlines(keepends=True),fromfile='before-helper-policy-fix',tofile='after-helper-policy-fix'))}
logs=[]
for command in capture['commands']:
    if command['id'].startswith('app-') and ('cancel-verification' in command['id'] or 'unexpected-exit' in command['id']) and '-independent' not in command['id']:
        path=repo/command['stdout_log'];logs.append({'command_id':command['id'],'sanitized_local_log':local_record(path),'native_stdout_bytes_sha256':command['stdout_native_bytes_sha256'],'excerpt_policy':'Last2048characters; complete local sanitized log remains ignored.','excerpt':path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')[-2048:]})
derivation={'publisher_invocation':sys.orig_argv,'publisher_source_sha256':sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes()),
            'policy':'Synthetic case outcomes, hashes, command metadata and bounded progress/log projections. No audio/binary PCM/full raw report or repeated full log. Physical runtime equality is checked at capture/publication; parent owns later checkpoint/console/Full records.'}
media={'task':'WAC-M3-04','status':'pass','scope':'Fresh unfiltered20 cases on both PS5.1/en-US and PS7/de-DE, pinned FFmpeg9.0.2. Two cases prove actual unknown-duration native indeterminate progress with null sink and separate app rejection4; they do not export unknown media.',
       'notice':'Actual per-run Request cancellation after positive structured progress while exact owned FFmpeg was alive. Copied input pacing and unexpected exact-owned-PID Kill are labeled. Independent survivors were alive after the request and completed normally. Genuine generated console-control tests are separate parent evidence; no typed keyboard, Explorer, listening or stress claim.',
       'derivation':derivation,'counts':counts,'capture':dict(local_record(capture_path),harness_invocation=capture['harness_invocation'],source_revision=capture['source_revision'],
                   started_utc=capture['started_utc'],finished_utc=capture['finished_utc'],wrapper_exit=0,source_sha256_before=capture['source_sha256_before'],source_sha256_after=capture['source_sha256_after'],
                   guards={key:capture[key] for key in guard_names},copies_before=capture['instrumentation']['copies_before'],copies_sha256_after=capture['copies_sha256_after']),
       'runtime_sha256_at_publication':runtime_now,'tools':capture['tools'],'tools_sha256_after':capture['tools_sha256_after'],
       'fixtures':capture['fixtures'],'cases':cases,'references':references,'commands':capture['commands'],'selected_log_excerpts':logs,
       'actual_cancelled_native_classification':cancelled_native_results,
       'preliminary_history':preliminary,'previous_accepted_capture':previous_accepted,'harness_correction':correction,
       'baseline':'Fast synthetic stereo8second Original16 PCM matches maintained M3-03 media baseline90dc489de7cd4b96f89fa561b6455ff2fe53e02e8933fde2b4148ce101df7f96. Other selected sound/format/graph choices match fresh ordinary single-file references on the same pinned source/build.',
       'log_hash_policy':'Native byte hashes and sanitized local-text-file hashes are separate. Public projection hashes are recorded by the manifest; complete local logs remain ignored.'}
files=[publish('WAC-M3-04-media.json',media)]
harnesses=[]
for name in ['test-progress-media.py','publish-progress-evidence.py']:
    original=(scratch/name).read_bytes();text=sanitized(original.decode('utf-8'))
    harnesses.append({'local_path':(scratch/name).relative_to(repo).as_posix(),'local_physical_sha256':sha(original),'published_utf8_source_sha256':sha(text.encode('utf-8')),'source_utf8_text':text})
files.append(publish('WAC-M3-04-media-harness.json',{'task':'WAC-M3-04','development_only':True,'derivation':derivation,'harnesses':harnesses,'initial_final_harness_reconstruction':correction,
                                                  'replay':'Save UTF8 source under ignored M3-04 scratch preserving newlines, verify recorded source/tool hashes, run the recorded final command with a fresh output directory. Python remains development-only.'}))
publish('WAC-M3-04-media-manifest.json',{'task':'WAC-M3-04','status':'pass','public_files':files,'derivation':derivation,'local_capture':local_record(capture_path)})
for path in destination.glob('WAC-M3-04-media*.json'):
    text=path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    require(not re.search(r'c:[\\/]+users[\\/]+|c:[\\/]+projects[\\/]+WinAudioClean-governance',text,re.I),'Private path in '+path.name)
    require(not any(os.environ.get(key) and os.environ[key].lower() in text.lower() for key in ['USERNAME','COMPUTERNAME','USERDOMAIN']),'Private identity in '+path.name)
print('Public privacy scan passed.')
